# SpaceBreath

> SpaceBreath creates guided breathwork sessions with original music, thoughtful guidance and nature-led films. Sessions are available in English, Spanish and German.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.space-breath.com/): About SpaceBreath, the creative team and the latest release.
- [Sessions](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/): The complete guided breathwork archive.
- [Where We Breathe](https://www.space-breath.com/locations/): An atlas of the countries, landscapes and filming locations behind SpaceBreath sessions.

## Individual session guides

- [Release Thoughts & Tension](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/release-thoughts-and-tension/): 16 minutes, three rounds, 60 BPM, longer exhales and progressive exhale holds.
- [Respiración para calmar tus pensamientos](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/respiracion-para-calmar-tus-pensamientos/): 15-minute guided session in Spanish with three rounds at 70 BPM.
- [Joy, Calm and Gratitude](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/breathing-practice-for-joy-calm-and-gratitude/): Eight minutes, two rounds of connected breathing at 70 BPM.
- [Quick Activation](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/quick-activation-psychedelic-breathwork/): Eight-minute active practice with two rounds of fast breathing at 87 BPM.
- [Wake Up Your Mind](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/wake-up-your-mind-activating-breathwork/): Eight minutes, three activating rounds, strong inhales, relaxed exhales and one-minute breath holds.
- [Breathwork for Mental Clarity](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/breathwork-for-mental-clarity/): Seven-minute, two-round practice using a triple-inhale pattern and progressive exhale holds.
- [Coherent Breathing](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/coherent-breathing-nervous-system-reset/): Gentle six-second nasal inhales and six-second nasal exhales with original music at 60 BPM.
- [Rhythmic Breathing for Energy](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/rhythmic-breathing-for-energy/): Three rounds using an in, out, in-in, out pattern with progressively longer holds.
- [Box Breathing for Calm](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/box-breathing-technique-for-calm/): Seven-minute guided 4-4-4-4 box breathing practice.
- [Psychedelic Breathwork Journey](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/psychedelic-breathwork-journey/): A 30-minute, four-round psychedelic-inspired journey with progressive inhale and exhale holds.
- [Calm an Overactive Mind](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/calm-an-overactive-mind/): Three rounds with slow and faster breathing phases and progressively longer exhale holds.
- [Respiración Psicodélica](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/respiracion-psicodelica/): Una sesión en español de 21 minutos con tres rondas de respiración rápida y conectada.
- [Breathwork Over Coffee](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/breathwork-over-coffee/): An eight-minute morning practice that gradually builds from slow to fast breathing.
- [3 Rounds to Real Happiness](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/three-rounds-to-real-happiness/): A 24-minute guided practice centred on joy, gratitude and three progressive breath holds.
- [Full Body Activation](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/full-body-activation-energy-breathwork/): A 13-minute energy practice with three active rounds and progressive inhale and exhale holds.
- [Somatic Breathwork to Feel Grounded](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/somatic-breathwork-release-stress/): A gentle 20-minute practice using four-second inhales, eight-second exhales and three progressive holds.
- [Wim Hof Style Energy Breathwork](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/wim-hof-style-energy-breathwork/): A short, active three-round practice with three increasing breathing paces in each round.
- [Nervous System Reset Breathwork](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/nervous-system-reset-breathwork/): Three progressively faster rounds followed by exhale holds of one, one and a half, and two minutes.
- [4-7-8 Breathing for Sleep](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/four-seven-eight-breathing-for-sleep/): An eight-minute evening practice using a four-count inhale, seven-count hold and eight-count exhale.
- [Wim Hof Style Pure Energy](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/wim-hof-style-pure-energy-breathwork/): A 15-minute two-round practice that builds into active breathing before a slower cool-down.
- [Evening Breathwork to Unwind](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/evening-breathwork-to-unwind/): Three gentle rounds using four-second inhales, six-second exhales and progressive exhale holds.
- [Morning Breathwork for Calm Focus](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/morning-breathwork-calm-focus-gratitude/): A 13-minute progression through grounding, activation and cool-down at 65 BPM.
- [Psychedelic Breathing auf Deutsch](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/psychedelic-breathing-drei-runden/): Eine deutschsprachige Session mit drei Runden schneller verbundener Atmung und progressiven Atempausen.
- [Psychedelic Breathing](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/psychedelic-breathing-three-rounds/): Three guided rounds of fast connected breathing with progressively longer inhale and exhale holds.
- [Energie für den ganzen Körper](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/energie-ganzer-koerper-power-breathing/): Eine deutschsprachige Vier-Runden-Session mit zwei aktiven und zwei ruhigeren Phasen.
- [Full Body Energiser](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/full-body-energiser-four-rounds/): Four rounds that move from active power breathing into a slower cool-down with longer exhale holds.
- [Kreative Energie](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/kreative-energie-atemuebung/): Eine deutschsprachige Drei-Runden-Praxis mit wechselnden Atemtempi und kreativem Fokus.
- [Unlock Creative Flow](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/creative-flow-breathwork/): Three rounds with changing breathing speeds, inhale holds and a reflective focus on expression.
- [Tiefe innere Ruhe](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/tiefe-innere-ruhe-atemuebung/): Vier Runden tiefer Atmung mit progressiven Pausen nach der Ausatmung von einer bis zweieinhalb Minuten.
- [Wim Hof Style Deep Reset](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/wim-hof-style-deep-reset/): Four active rounds with progressively longer exhale holds from one minute to two minutes 30 seconds.
- [Schneller Reset](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/schneller-reset-atemuebung/): Eine deutschsprachige Drei-Runden-Praxis mit tiefer Bauch-Brust-Atmung und progressiven Atempausen.
- [Wim Hof Style Breathwork for Beginners](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/wim-hof-style-breathwork-for-beginners/): A beginner-friendly three-round introduction to active breathing and progressive exhale holds.
- [Respiración Coherente](https://www.space-breath.com/sessions/respiracion-coherente/): Una práctica guiada en español con inhalaciones y exhalaciones nasales de seis segundos.

## Content notes

- Individual session pages are the preferred source for each practice's duration, breathing structure, timestamps, transcript, music details and safety guidance.
- SpaceBreath content is for education and general wellbeing, not medical advice. Visitors should follow the safety guidance on each session page.
